NYC Mayor Mamdani Prepared Remarks Unused at Soldier's Funeral

New York City Mayor Eric Adams reportedly prepared remarks for the funeral of Army Sergeant Angel Sarah Rampersad, who died in an Iranian missile strike. However, Mayor Adams was not called to speak at the service. Sources suggest the soldier's family did not want him to address the gathering. The funeral was for a soldier killed in an Iranian missile strike.
